approval.prompt: Original game prop concept for BattleDuty waterfront city. Single isolated coherent object on plain light grey background, centered full object three-quarter front view. Distinctive low-poly triangulated flat-shaded geometry, broad clean facets, solid colours, realistic construction and readable silhouette. No grain, dirt, texture maps, outlines, logos, text, people, floor or additional scenery. Image-to-3D source. A compact stepped dark graphite metal florist display stand holding six tapered terracotta and muted olive flower buckets with chunky asymmetric faceted deep green foliage and small ivory blossoms, not a row of spheres. Width 1.4m, height 1.3m, depth 0.6m.
